summary: Require DSL at every LLM decision boundary

delivery.outcome: Every enabled LLM decision boundary is an explicit strict DSL request-response exchange; NL is allowed only as a typed human source that is translated to DSL.
nonGoals: Migrate consumer repositories in this ticket
Change SubLLM provider routing or credentials
Grant model execution authority or bypass receipts and readback
Change branch protection, publish a release, or merge a pull request

architecture.decision: Extend the existing LLM manifest contract with a closed decisionProtocol vocabulary and enforce it in the dependency-free DSL checker.
dataChanges: Add llm.decisionProtocol to the DSL manifest contract.
architecture.rollback: Revert the contract and checker change together through a reviewed integration ticket.

validation.evidence: The root profile validates with the new closed vocabulary.
The self-test rejects missing, mismatched, and non-bidirectional decision protocols.
Governance accepts the bounded ticket and exact modified paths.
